title.zh: 用量子糾纏解開標準模型最後一塊拼圖：Λ超子衰變的突破性測量
title.en: Unlocking the Standard Model's Last Puzzle Piece: A Breakthrough Measurement in Λ Baryon Decay

summary.zh:
【總結】這項發表於《自然》的研究，首次利用量子糾纏與極化技術，精確測定了Λ超子半輕子衰變（Λ → pe⁻ν̄ₑ）的絕對分支比及多個關鍵耦合參數。研究團隊結合格點量子色動力學（LQCD）計算，得到了|V_us| = 0.2339 ± 0.0041的結果，與卡比博－小林－益川（CKM）矩陣的幺正性高度一致。這項工作不僅填補了超過三十年來的實驗空白，更為未來精確檢驗標準模型開闢了一條全新路徑。

【研究問題】CKM矩陣的幺正性是標準模型的基石，而|V_us|——描述奇夸克與上夸克之間轉換的參數——的精确測量至關重要。過去三十年間，關於Λ超子半輕子衰變的實驗進展緩慢，主要原因在於缺乏足夠的運動學信息，導致測量對關鍵形態因子不敏感。此外，不同理論模型對SU(3)味對稱性破缺修正的預測存在分歧，進一步限制了|V_us|的精度。解決這個問題，對於檢驗標準模型是否完整、探索新物理跡象具有深遠意義。

【研究方法】研究團隊利用北京正負電子對撞機（BEPCII）上的BESIII探測器，收集了超過100億個J/ψ共振事件。J/ψ衰變產生的ΛΛ̄對處於量子糾纏態，這意味著通過觀測其中一個Λ的衰變產物（反質子與π⁺），可以推斷另一個Λ的極化狀態。研究人員採用「雙標記技術」——一邊重建半輕子衰變，另一邊重建強子衰變——從而精確確定分支比。同時，他們通過七維運動學變量的最大似然擬合，提取軸矢量耦合（g_av）、弱磁性耦合（g_w）和首次測定的弱電力耦合（g_av2）。

【結果】研究測得Λ → pe⁻ν̄ₑ的絕對分支比為(8.16 ± 0.22 ± 0.15) × 10⁻⁴，與世界平均值一致。軸矢量耦合g_av = 0.706⁺⁰·⁰⁸⁹₋₀·₀₈₆，弱磁性耦合g_w = 0.89 ± 0.38，而弱電力耦合g_av2 = −0.19⁺⁰·⁶⁵₋₀·₆₃——這是該參數的首次測量。結合格點QCD結果，得到|V_us|_LQCD = 0.2339 ± 0.0041，在1.4σ水平上與CKM幺正性相符。與Fermilab三十年前的實驗相比，儘管數據量僅为其約二十分之一，但研究團隊在g_w的精度上已達到相當水平，且首次測得了此前無法觸及的g_av2。
summary.en:
**Summary:** Published in Nature, this study achieves the first precise measurement of the absolute branching fraction and key coupling parameters in the semileptonic decay of the Λ baryon (Λ → pe⁻ν̄ₑ), by exploiting the polarization and quantum entanglement of ΛΛ̄ pairs produced at the J/ψ resonance. Combining experimental results with lattice QCD calculations, the team extracted |V_us| = 0.2339 ± 0.0041, consistent with CKM unitarity. This breakthrough fills a more than thirty-year experimental gap and establishes a new methodology for precision tests of the Standard Model.

**Problem:** The unitarity of the CKM matrix is a cornerstone of the Standard Model, and |V_us|—the parameter governing the transition between strange and up quarks—is critical to verify it. For over three decades, progress in measuring Λ semileptonic decay has been hindered by insufficient kinematic information, leaving experiments insensitive to the relevant form factors. Moreover, theoretical models disagree on SU(3) flavor symmetry-breaking corrections, limiting the precision of |V_us| determinations. Resolving this tension is essential for testing whether the Standard Model is complete or hints at new physics.

**Approach:** The collaboration used the BESIII detector at the BEPCII collider, analyzing over 10 billion J/ψ events. The J/ψ decays into entangled ΛΛ̄ pairs, meaning that observing the decay of one Λ (into an antiproton and π⁺) reveals the polarization state of its partner. The team employed a double-tagging technique—one side reconstructs the semileptonic decay, the other the hadronic decay—to precisely determine the branching fraction. An unbinned maximum log-likelihood fit to seven kinematic variables allowed simultaneous extraction of the axial-vector coupling (g_av), weak-magnetism coupling (g_w), and, for the first time, the weak-electricity coupling (g_av2).

**Results:** The absolute branching fraction was measured as (8.16 ± 0.22 ± 0.15) × 10⁻⁴, consistent with the world average. The axial-vector coupling is g_av = 0.706⁺⁰·⁰⁸⁹₋₀·₀₈₆, the weak-magnetism coupling g_w = 0.89 ± 0.38, and the weak-electricity coupling g_av2 = −0.19⁺⁰·⁶⁵₋₀·₆₃—the latter a first-ever measurement. Using lattice QCD form factors, |V_us|_LQCD = 0.2339 ± 0.0041, consistent with CKM unitarity at the 1.4σ level. Remarkably, despite having roughly twenty times fewer events than the pioneering Fermilab experiment, the team achieved comparable precision on g_w and uniquely accessed g_av2 for the first time.

keyArticle.title: Exploring baryon semileptonic decays through polarization and entanglement
